purpose: Raster provenance for the Tagrove introduction page under site/. Every image the page ships is listed with where it came from.
honestyRule: Interface screenshots are real application output. Reference material (the photographs and documents pinned on the wall) is synthetic. The page states this distinction in its footer.

realInterface.how: Captured from the built desktop application through the project's own QA harness, not mocked in HTML. scripts/landing-captures.cjs launches src-tauri/target/release/shiqian.exe against an isolated library under qa/v0-landing/library over CDP, seeds the state through the app's own api actions (import, tag.create, annotation.apply, note.save, settings.save), then photographs the window with Playwright (animations disabled). Re-run: python scripts/make-landing-material.py && node scripts/landing-captures.cjs
realInterface.build: 0.6.13 test build; layout matches the 0.6.12 stable release. Re-shoot against the stable build before a version-specific claim is made.

assets.ui/workspace.webp: 全部资料 with nine seeded items, sidebar groups, folder and tag index, masonry with a rendered PDF page.
assets.ui/search.webp: Search for 外墙: three hits, each labelled 命中 · 标签, with the real 正文索引未开启 notice.
assets.ui/reader-pdf.webp: Inspector reading the sample PDF in continuous mode with page navigation and fit controls.
assets.ui/annotation.webp: A Markdown file carrying 参考 / 项目参考 / 待讨论 on its card, with the reader open beside it.
assets.ui/palette-light.webp: The desktop floating tag palette, light theme, 未分类 group with per-tag nine-dot handles.
assets.ui/workspace-dark.webp: The same library in the dark theme.

syntheticMaterial.how: AI-generated stand-ins for a visitor's own reference material, produced with the Qoder Desktop image tool and re-encoded with Pillow (JPEG q84-88). They are not Tagrove users' files and not real project records. The same set is imported by qa/make-landing-material.py to drive the captures above.

assets.tower-dusk.jpg: Sample rendering of a glass tower at dusk, used on the wall and as the 江畔塔楼-黄昏-01.jpg fixture.
assets.facade-detail.jpg: Sample board-formed concrete facade detail; fixture 立面细部-混凝土.jpg.
assets.material-board.jpg: Sample material sample board; fixture 材料样板-外立面.jpg.
assets.node-drawing.jpg: Sample construction detail drawing on tracing paper; fixture 墙身节点-1比20.jpg.
assets.plaster.jpg: Tiled wall texture for the page ground; generated as a seamless plaster surface.
assets.logo.png: Pre-existing project asset public/icon.png, the transparent logo source named in README and docs/brand-update-2026-10-19.zh-CN.md; resized 2048 to 512 for web.

engineNote: The Impeccable engine could not be installed on this host during the first pass (its binary is fetched from a github.com release URL, which is blocked here); a partial copy exists under ~/.impeccable/bin/0.1.14 and has not been verified by digest. Provenance is therefore recorded in this file rather than embedded in each image.
